name: tool-router
description: Decision checklist that maps a single task to exactly one shipped tool. Helps small models pick the right tool deterministically instead of guessing. Routes atomic capabilities to: terminal (shell/build/test commands), web-browser (live/interactive pages), browserless (static headless page fetch), python-shell (Python computation/scripts), skills (invoke/compose a saved skill), blender-bridge (Blender/3D scene ops), 3dtool (inspect/transform a 3D asset file), lan-sub-agent (delegate a subtask to a LAN agent), and ask_user_interview (ask the user a structured question). Output is the one chosen tool, its exact input, and a one-line justification.

task.description: The task to route to a single tool

constraints.description: Execution constraints: environment, offline/online, token budget, time limit

steps.template:
Task: {{task}}
Constraints: {{constraints}}

Step 1 — Identify the capability:
- Restate the task in one sentence.
- Restate the constraints (or 'none').
- Name the single atomic capability the task needs (e.g., run a command, fetch a page, compute, delegate, ask the user).
- If the task bundles several capabilities, pick the one primary capability to route now; note the rest as follow-ups.

Step 2 — Decision checklist (map the capability to ONE shipped tool; stop at the first match):
- Run a shell/build/test command → terminal
- Fetch a live/interactive web page (JS, login, clicks) → web-browser
- Fetch a static page/HTML headlessly → browserless
- Run a Python computation or script → python-shell
- Invoke or compose a saved skill → skills
- Control Blender / do 3D scene ops → blender-bridge
- Inspect or transform a 3D asset file → 3dtool
- Delegate a subtask to a LAN agent → lan-sub-agent
- Ask the user a structured question → ask_user_interview

Walk the checklist top to bottom and choose the first rule whose condition the capability satisfies.

Step 3 — Output the routing decision:
- Tool: the single chosen tool name
- Input: the exact input it needs (concrete values, not placeholders)
- Justification: one line on why this tool fits the capability

Output format:
Tool: <tool>
Input: <exact input>
Why: <one-line justification>
